The '''B'omarr Monastery''' was a structure on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] that bore similar design to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Teth_Monastery_entrance.png|thumb|left|220px|The monastery entrance]]
The monastery stood atop a large mesa in the Teth jungle. The castle consisted of lower levels where the prisoners were kept, a throne room, a monster pit underneath the throne room that contained a [[Jungle rancor/Legends|jungle rancor]], and a back door landing pad.

==History==
The monastery on Teth was originally a dwelling of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monks]],<ref name="CW Film" /> and at some point in its history was inhabited by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and their [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="CW Storybook" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the monastery served as a hideout for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]]-aligned captors of [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] landed on the world in an attempt to rescue the Huttlet, initiating the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. Skywalker's forces battled against [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a Separatist army, successfully extracting Rotta from captivity.<ref name="CW Film" />

==Behind the scenes==
In one adventure path the reader may take in the story of [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] can order [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to lay [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] in order to blow up the B'omarr Monastery.<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>
